content: The BC Cancer Agency is an integral part of the Provincial Health Services Authority in British Columbia, Canada. The agency's mission is threefold: 1. To decrease the incidence of cancer within the population. 2. To lower the mortality rate among individuals diagnosed with cancer. 3. To enhance the quality of life for those living with cancer. The BC Cancer Agency operates four regional cancer care centers and the BC Cancer Research Centre, with facilities located in Vancouver and Victoria. It is responsible for providing nearly all radiotherapy services in British Columbia, as well as the majority of chemotherapy services. To ensure accessibility, the agency also runs clinics in remote areas outside the four main cancer centers, serving rural regions of British Columbia and the Yukon. Additionally, the agency offers prostate brachytherapy services to the province of Saskatchewan.
